scripts.lint: oxlint src tests scripts public/sw.js vite.config.ts vitest.unit.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts vitest.firebase.config.ts
scripts.test:firebase: firebase --config firebase.rules-test.json emulators:exec --only database --project demo-simple-games "vitest run --config vitest.firebase.config.ts"
scripts.coverage:firebase: firebase --config firebase.rules-test.json emulators:exec --only database --project demo-simple-games "vitest run --config vitest.firebase.config.ts --coverage"
scripts.test:app: npm run test:unit && npm run test:firebase
scripts.app:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run seed:validate && npm run test:app
scripts.check: npm run app:check && npm run push:check
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:unit && npm run coverage:firebase && npm run coverage:push && node scripts/merge-coverage.mjs
scripts.production:build: node scripts/check-env.mjs production && npm run check && vite build --mode production
